limitations: Frozen tasks reused; this is an intervention/effort study, not a new-task generalization test.
Skill effect includes installation, discovery and loading with an identical conditional invocation prompt, not just the 94-character body.
Cache warmth is not controllable; report uncached, cached and output components separately.
A fixed-budget descriptive study; no power calculation or universal quality claim.
No global setting change; single-turn desktop-bundled headless engine, not GUI or production validation.
